name: Herod the Great
bio: Herod the Great, king of Judea, was troubled when wise men from the east arrived seeking a newborn "King of the Jews" whose star they had followed. Learning from the chief priests and scribes that the Messiah was prophesied to be born in Bethlehem, he sent the wise men there under the pretense of wanting to worship the child himself, secretly intending to have him killed. When the wise men, warned in a dream, returned home another way without reporting back, Herod flew into a rage and ordered the massacre of all boys two years old and under in Bethlehem and its vicinity. Joseph, warned by an angel, had already fled with Mary and Jesus to Egypt, where they stayed until Herod's death (Matthew 2:1-19).
